description:
# Generative AI Job Descriptions

Use LLMs to generate job descriptions based on role and requirements.

## Rationale
Writing job descriptions is time-consuming. AI creates high-quality descriptions faster.

## User Stories
- As a recruiter, I want AI to write job descriptions

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Job descriptions generated from role title
- [ ] Descriptions are inclusive and unbiased
workflow_rationale: Feature workflow is appropriate because this is a new feature being added to the system with clear backend and frontend components. Backend provides the AI generation service, and frontend provides the user interface.

phases.name: Backend Job Description Analyzer
phases.description: Create the LLM-based job description generator that produces inclusive, unbiased job descriptions from role titles and requirements.

subtasks.description: Create JobDescriptionGenerator analyzer with LLM integration

verification.command: cd backend && python -c "from analyzers.job_description_generator import JobDescriptionGenerator; print('Import OK')"

subtasks.notes:
Created JobDescriptionGenerator analyzer with LLM integration. The module includes:
- LLM integration supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Zai providers
- JobDescriptionResult and JobDescriptionSection dataclasses
- Comprehensive system prompt with inclusive language guidelines
- Bias detection via _check_inclusive_language method
- Async and sync wrapper methods
- Singleton pattern with get_job_description_generator() convenience function
- Full documentation and type hints

Created comprehensive unit tests for JobDescriptionGenerator (1093 lines). Tests cover:
- TestJobDescriptionGeneratorInit: Initialization with different LLM providers
- TestSystemPrompt: System prompt with inclusive language guidelines
- TestDescriptionPromptCreation: Prompt creation with all parameters
- TestInclusiveLanguageChecking: Bias detection and scoring
- TestFullDescriptionFormatting: Description formatting with custom sections
- TestLLMProviderCalls: API calls for all providers (Zai, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google)
- TestDescriptionGeneration: Main generation with validation and error handling
- TestSynchronousWrapper: Sync wrapper functionality
- TestHelperFunctions: Singleton and convenience functions
- TestDataClasses: Serialization for dataclasses
- Enum value validation for all enums

Note: Tests require manual verification due to Python command restrictions in the environment.

phases.name: Backend API Endpoints
phases.description: Create FastAPI endpoints for job description generation with proper error handling and internationalization.

subtasks.notes:
Created backend/api/job_descriptions.py with:
- JobDescriptionGenerator class integrated into the API module
- LLM support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Z.ai providers
- POST /api/job-descriptions/generate endpoint
- Bilingual system prompts (English and Russian)
- Pydantic request/response models with proper validation
- Error handling with internationalized messages
- Updated backend/api/__init__.py to export job_descriptions module
- Updated backend/main.py to include the job_descriptions router

The API endpoint accepts:
- title (required): Job title
- required_skills (required): List of required technical skills
- min_experience_months (optional): Minimum experience in months
- seniority_level (optional): Seniority level (junior, mid, senior, lead)
- industry, work_format, location, employment_type, salary_range (optional)
- additional_requirements (optional): Additional preferred skills
- tone (optional): Tone for description (professional, casual, formal, friendly)
- language (optional): Language for description (en, ru)

phases.name: Frontend API Client
phases.description: Create TypeScript API client for job description generation with proper error handling.

subtasks.notes:
Created the job descriptions API client (JobDescriptionsClient) with:
- generateDescription method for AI-powered job description generation
- Proper error handling with transformError method
- Axios instance with 60-second timeout for LLM operations
- Singleton export (jobDescriptionsClient)
- Type re-exports for convenience
- Comprehensive JSDoc documentation with examples

Also added the API types to frontend/src/types/api.ts:
- JobDescriptionGenerateRequest interface with all optional fields (title, required_skills, min_experience_months, seniority_level, industry, work_format, location, employment_type, salary_range, additional_requirements, tone, language)
- JobDescriptionResponse interface (title, summary, responsibilities, requirements, benefits, company_culture, interview_process, provider, model, generated_at)

The client follows the established patterns from vacancies.ts and interviews.ts, including consistent error messages, interceptor setup, and default configuration.

subtasks.notes:

- Required and additional skill management with memoized SkillChip components
- Experience slider (0-120 months) with human-readable labels
- Work format, employment type, location, industry, and salary range inputs

- Tone selection (professional, casual, formal, friendly)
- Language selection (English, Russian)
- Loading state with CircularProgress during generation
- Error handling with ErrorMessage component and retry/reset actions
- Generated description display with all sections (summary, responsibilities, requirements, benefits, company culture, interview process)
- Regenerate and edit functionality
- Embedded mode support for use in other pages
- ErrorBoundary wrapper for error handling
- Memoized components for performance optimization
